findings.current: Seeing the wet-behind-the-ears pups waiting for him atop the walls surrounding the Sichuan Tang Clan like an impregnable fortress, a little over a hundred yards ahead, put him in an excellent mood.
findings.defect: 백여 장 is roughly three hundred yards, not a little over one hundred yards, so the draft substantially changes the distance.
findings.rationale: A jang is approximately three meters; about one hundred jang is therefore approximately three hundred meters, or somewhat over three hundred yards.
findings.replacement: Seeing the wet-behind-the-ears pups waiting for him atop the walls surrounding the Sichuan Tang Clan like an impregnable fortress, roughly three hundred yards ahead, put him in an excellent mood.
findings.source: 백여 장 앞, 철옹성처럼 사천당문을 둘러싼 성벽 위에서 자신을 기다리는 하룻강아지들을 보니 기분이 썩 유쾌해진다.

findings.current: He had been born ugly, a difficult birth from the start.
findings.defect: The draft conflates his ugly appearance with the difficult childbirth and produces an unclear causal statement.
findings.rationale: 난산 explicitly denotes a difficult childbirth, while 추한 생김새를 타고났다 separately states that he was born ugly.
findings.replacement: His had been a difficult birth, and he had been born with ugly features.
findings.source: 태어나길 난산(難産)이라, 추한 생김새를 타고났다.

findings.current: When they finally looked around, the people who had despised them for their ugliness and pelted the three brothers with stones were all drowning in pools of blood.
findings.defect: “Were drowning” depicts an ongoing action by living victims, whereas the source says they were submerged in pools of blood after the brothers' killing spree.
findings.rationale: 잠겨 있었다 describes the victims' resulting state, not the act of drowning.
findings.replacement: When they finally looked around, the people who had despised them for their ugliness and pelted the three brothers with stones all lay submerged in pools of blood.
findings.source: 문득 주위를 둘러보았을 때는 추하다 멸시하며 세 형제에게 돌팔매질하던 이들이 모두 피 웅덩이에 잠겨 있었다.

findings.current: Cheongpung lowered the food he had been holding and spoke.
findings.defect: The draft changes Cheongpung's action from setting the food down to merely lowering it.
findings.rationale: 내려놓다 means to put or set something down.
findings.replacement: Cheongpung set down the food he had been holding and spoke.
findings.source: 청풍이 손에 쥐고 있던 먹거리를 내려놓으며 입을 열었다.

findings.current: Considering the forces Dark Heaven had deployed against Shaolin Temple, escaping might only lead us straight into a dead end.
findings.defect: “Dead end” means an impassable route, while 사지 means a place of almost certain death; the draft weakens the lethal consequence of attempting an escape.
findings.rationale: 사지 literally denotes deadly ground or a place from which one is unlikely to return alive.
findings.replacement: Considering the forces Dark Heaven had deployed against Shaolin Temple, escaping might only lead us straight into a deathtrap.
findings.source: 소림사를 쳤던 암천의 전력을 떠올려보면 오히려 사지(死地)에 발을 디디는 결과를 불러올 수도 있다.

findings.current: The Second Fiend had left to deal with Qingcheng, while the Third Fiend had departed for Emei.
findings.defect: The draft renders only the Second Fiend as handling an objective and reduces the Third Fiend's parallel assignment to mere travel.
findings.rationale: 맡아 applies to both brothers and indicates that each was assigned responsibility for one sect.
findings.replacement: The Second Fiend had left to take charge of Qingcheng, while the Third Fiend had gone to take charge of Emei.
findings.source: 이괴(二怪)는 청성, 삼괴(三怪)는 아미를 맡아 떠났으니까.

findings.current: “We were so young back then. We killed this one and that one, then killed some more…”
findings.defect: “This one and that one” erases the gendered, contemptuous register of 이놈, 저년 and sanitizes the speaker's vicious recollection.
findings.rationale: 놈 and 년 are derogatory references to men and women respectively, and 할 것 없이 means without distinction.
findings.replacement: “We were so young back then. Bastard or bitch, we killed them all, then killed some more…”
findings.source: “그때는 우리도 참 젊었지. 이놈, 저년 할 것 없이 죽이고 또 죽였는데…….”

findings.current: At that very moment, a small figure shot forward at a speed more dazzling than anyone else’s.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the Tang Clan martial artists were shaken by the armor's resistance immediately before the First Fiend charged.
findings.rationale: 당문의 무인들이 동요하는 explicitly supplies the defenders' shaken reaction and the timing of the charge.
findings.replacement: As the Tang Clan martial artists faltered, a small figure streaked forward faster than anyone else.
findings.source: 당문의 무인들이 동요하는 그 순간, 다른 누구보다 눈부신 속도로 쏘아지는 자그마한 신형이 있었다.

findings.current: “Activate the Myriad-Poison Formation! Activate the Myriad-Poison Formation!”
findings.defect: The first clipped cry merely names the formation; turning it into a complete repeated command changes the panicked cadence.
findings.rationale: The source first blurts out 만독진 as a standalone exclamation, then gives the command to activate it.
findings.replacement: “The Myriad-Poison Formation! Activate the Myriad-Poison Formation!”

findings.current: “As I said before, his energy has not stabilized yet. If he receives an external shock in this condition…”
findings.defect: Generic “energy” fails to identify the unstable Murim qi that makes an external shock dangerous.
findings.rationale: In this Murim medical context, 기운 refers to qi rather than generic energy or Hunter-system mana.
findings.replacement: “As I said before, his qi has not stabilized yet. If he receives an external shock in this condition…”
findings.source: “지난번에 말했듯이 아직 기운이 안정되지 않았소. 만약 이 상태에서 외부의 충격을 받는다면…….”

findings.current: The old man curled up the corners of his mouth.
findings.defect: “Curled up the corners” is an unnatural English collocation.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally conveys 입꼬리를 말아 올렸다 without changing the physical expression.
findings.replacement: The old man curled the corners of his mouth upward.

findings.defect: The draft romanizes the Korean sound effect instead of rendering the sound of many weapons being drawn in English.
findings.rationale: The sound accompanies hundreds of weapons being unsheathed and should read as an English metallic sound effect.

findings.defect: The Quest title retains square brackets inside a System panel, contrary to the required System-window formatting.
findings.rationale: The blockquote and System heading already identify the interface, and the binding Markdown rules prohibit enclosing System UI terms in square brackets.

summary: Several factual and register errors require correction, including a substantially shortened distance, altered physical actions, lost assignment roles, softened contempt, and Murim-energy terminology.
